collectionMethod: Manual capture around 10:35 Beijing time / 02:35Z on 2026-11-19 of the official OpenCode Go documentation page (https://opencode.ai/docs/go/, which 301-redirects to /docs/console/go/), the Go landing page (https://opencode.ai/go, 302-redirects to /console/go), the documentation markdown export (https://opencode.ai/docs/console/go.md), the OpenCode console changelog RSS feed (https://opencode.ai/console/changelog/rss.xml) and the full model catalog endpoint referenced by the documentation (https://opencode.ai/inference/go/v1/models). All surfaces were compared against the 2026-11-18 captures of the same URLs. Every price, limit, estimate and promo sentence below is transcribed as published. Research-only — no adopted row generated, no adopted value changed, no script changed, no chart or site change.
scope: OpenCode Go official catalog only. The change on 2026-11-19 is that the published monthly limit for GLM-5.3 moved from Go $200 / Go Plus $400 / Go Teams $205 (recorded in opencode-go-glm53-limit-round1-2026-11-18.json, which had no end date on the catalog surfaces) to Go $500 / Go Plus $1000 / Go Teams $505. The official documentation now states: 'GLM-5.3: Higher usage limits apply through November 22, 2026.' The three-part token price is unchanged. GLM-5.3-Flash and every other paid model's monthly_usage in the models API are unchanged. Research-only — not adopted; no computed allowance, no script change, no leaderboard/score data.
adoptionStatus: research-only; not adopted; the opencode_go × glm-5.3 adopted row is generated from scripts/build_adopted.py OPENCODE_GO_MODELS; updating it from the previously recorded $200 Go monthly limit (or the still-hardcoded earlier $15) to the new $500 monthly limit, and applying the 2026-11-22 end date, is left to maintainer review
